text:
marco: Heads-up 1: Beacon Health (pilot) asked for regional reserved throughput in EU-west with a 'preemptible spillover' add-on. They want burst capacity to spill to hosted on-demand without latency SLO hits.

lena: What does "preemptible spillover" mean operationally? do they want us to spin up extra Dedicated GPUs or route to hosted autoscale?

sarah: Beacon says they need 95th pct latency <200ms for committed traffic, but are ok with degraded latency on spilled requests. They want no additional commit & only pay on spilled tokens.

kevin: From infra perspective: we can tag route weight and route overflow to hosted pool. But need clear throttles and cost pass-through. Also region egress + cross-tenant isolation is tricky.

financebot: Quick calc: if spillover is 20% of peak for 6 months, expected billback could be ~ $18k/mo at current on-demand. Need a minimum monthly floor.

marco: Beacon legal insists spill events not be used to re-evaluate long term commit during the pilot. they want a written non-recalibration clause.

legalbot: We can include a pilot carveout: "Spillover usage during the pilot will not count towards baseline commit negotiations for a period of 180 days post-pilot." Need precise measurement hooks.

lena: Proposal for product API surface: extend route config with `spillover_policy` {"mode":"hosted","max_spill_percent":30,"billing":"pass_through","preemptible":true}. Example: ```json
{
  "spillover_policy": {"mode":"hosted", "max_spill_percent":25, "billing":"pass_through", "preemptible":true}
}
```
This gives runtime control.

sarah: Also require SLA tiers on committed vs spilled: commit = latency SLO 95% <200ms; spilled = best-effort with higher latency bucket and distinct error codes for customer analytics.

kevin: Need deterministic triggers for spill start/stop: e.g., committed queue depth > 75% for 3min OR serving CPU >80% -> enable spill. Stop when both below 60% for 5min. Put these in runbook.

marco: Sales ask: Beacon wants dashboard visibility of spill events and per-route cost. They want weekly export for internal chargebacks.

lena: Console work: surface "spill usage" metric per route and a rolling count of spill windows. We'll emit events `spill.start`, `spill.end`, `spill.tokens`. Sarah can we standardize event shapes?

sarah: Yep. Will propose event schema tonight. Minimal fields: route_id, start_ts, end_ts, tokens, region, reason_code.

financebot: Billing text draft: "Spilled requests are billed at on-demand hosted rates and subject to a monthly minimum of $X for the pilot. Spill usage will be itemized in monthly invoice. Redwood reserves the right to cap spill volume if system health is at risk."

marco: Beacon will object to the last sentence. legalbot: replace with "reasonable protective measures" and include explicit triggers (see kevin) so customers know boundaries.

lena: Implementation note: need egress label to avoid cross-region surprises. We'll only allow spill_to_hosted within same cloud region; if not available, fail fast with 503 and reason_code=REGION_UNAVAILABLE.

kevin: Ops: add autoscale buffer of N=2 prewarmed instances for each dedicated pool with spill enabled to reduce cold start tail. extra cost accounted to Beacon as spill or optional prewarm addon.

marco: Customer negotiation point: Beacon asks for 1 free test spill window during onboarding (4h). ok?

sarah: fine as goodwill. We'll log it but it shouldn't change billing floor.

marco: Acceptance criteria for pilot sign-off: 1) spike simulation report showing <15% impact to neighbor tenants with 25% spill cap, 2) engineering spec + runbook with deterministic triggers, 3) Console metrics + weekly export, 4) pilot addendum with non-recalibration clause and billing floor, 5) finance sign-off on invoice flow.

kevin: I'll run a chaos sim next 72h to validate triggers. putting ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8234

financebot: INF-8234 estimated cost impact doc requested.

marco: Timeline: want pilot start in 3 weeks. Is that realistic?

lena: Tight but possible if we scope: minimal console hooks + runtime enforcement + legal/finance template. skip fancy exports for v1.

marco: Action items: lena -> spike the runtime change & PR for config by Mon. sarah -> event schema tonight. kevin -> chaos sim results by Thu. financebot -> propose billing floor by Tue. legalbot -> draft addendum by Wed. I'll coordinate Beacon expectations.
